title: Inviscid damping without derivatives near Couette flow
summary: We study the long-time dynamics near Couette flow for the 2D Euler equations in unbounded geometries. We identify a mechanism of nonlinear inviscid damping at Yudovich regularity, distinct from classical phase mixing: velocity decay driven by spatial evacuation of vorticity. The mechanism leads to a geometry-sign classification of the dynamics. In the infinite channel, small nonnegative bounded-vorticity perturbations undergo global damping without derivative assumptions.
